SIGN IN

Use your phone number and personal PIN to enter Mfugaji+.

Mfugaji+ remembers your sign-in on this device. You will only need to sign in again after you log out. Online multi-device accounts will be connected in the next stage.

CREATE OWNER ACCOUNT

This is your first time using this Mfugaji+ installation. Create the farm owner account you will use to sign in.

RESET OWNER PIN

Enter the owner phone number saved on this device and choose a new PIN.

This version stores accounts on this device. PIN recovery is therefore device-local; it is not yet a cloud identity-recovery system.

Mfugaji+ Cloud
Cloud connection: Not connected yet
This app is being prepared for one shared farm database. Once the backend is connected, worker invitations can be delivered automatically and the same farm data will be available on your phone and your workers' phones.
Farm Owners
Manage the two-owner structure of your farm. Owners / CEOs have full access and are not limited by worker permissions.
Staff Accounts
Create and manage worker accounts, phone invitations, and individual ON/OFF permissions.
Security
Owner PIN, worker access, and account security.
Audit Trail
Review who entered, changed, deleted, or performed actions in the system.
Important

Each worker will receive a unique invitation link by phone, activate their own account, and sign in from their own device. The Audit Trail will then record their identity. Cloud synchronization and automatic SMS delivery require the Mfugaji+ backend to be connected.

Settings

Manage this part of Mfugaji+.

Add Co-Owner

Create a separate Owner / CEO account for your business partner.

The co-owner will receive an invitation and create their own login PIN/password during activation. Owners have full access and do not use worker permission switches.

Add Worker Account

Create one account per worker.

Permissions
Turn ON everything this worker is allowed to access. Turn OFF anything you want to restrict.
The worker will create their own PIN/password after opening the invitation. You should not create or know the worker's PIN.

Switch User

Enter the user's phone number and PIN. Mfugaji+ will identify the account automatically.

Current User

Choose the name of the person using Mfugaji+ before entering records. New records will be linked to this user in the Audit Trail.

Flock Monitoring

Simple records for weight, feed, water and flock condition.

Batch 1

⚖️ Weight

Weigh birds only at Day 1, 7, 14, 21, 28, 35 and 42.

Checking weight schedule…

🌾 Feed

Do not measure feed every day. Mfugaji+ uses the dates and bag sizes you already record when bags are opened. When the next bag is opened, it calculates the previous bag's average kg/day.

💧 Water

Water is the one item we can record daily when practical, especially during hot weather.

👀 Flock Observation

Record anything unusual without creating another farm-operation record.

📊 Monitoring Summary

Batch Archive

All batches are kept here. Select any batch to open its complete report. Active and closed batches remain available.

MFUGAJI+ • BATCH MANAGEMENT

Your Active Batches

Select a batch to make it the current batch. Close a batch only when you are finished with it. Any unpaid credit will then carry forward to the next batch.

Closed Batches

Closed batches keep their original sales and reports. Only unpaid balances carry forward.
